title: PolicySetParams
description: Params for policy.set. The document is the MATRIX — seven effect rows — and may not name rules: a whole-document write made against a document read a minute ago deleted every standing answer a person had approved (nocx-39bly), and 'rules' present-and-empty is what a renderer serialising an empty list sends. One rule is written or forgotten at a time, through policy.setRule and policy.forgetRule.
